mapper.select: SELECT rr.RESV_NUM AS resvNum, rr.RESV_CHECK_IN AS resvCheckIn, m.USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, rm.ROOM_NAME AS roomName, p.PLAN_NAME AS planName, rr.RESV_PAY_METHOD AS resvPayMethod, rr.RESV_PAY_STATUS AS resvPayStatus, rr.RESV_PRICE AS resvPrice FROM ROOM_RESERVATION rr JOIN MEMBER m ON m.USER_MAIL = rr.USER_MAIL JOIN ROOM rm ON rm.ROOM_IDX = rr.ROOM_IDX LEFT JOIN PLAN p ON p.PLAN_IDX = rr.PLAN_IDX WHERE rr.ADMIN_IDX = #{adminIdx} AND rr.RESV_CHECK_IN >= #{rangeStart} AND rr.RESV_CHECK_IN < #{rangeEnd} ORDER BY rr.RESV_CHECK_IN DESC, rr.ROOM_RESV_NUM DESC

SELECT m.USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, rm.ROOM_NAME AS roomName, p.PLAN_NAME AS planName, r.RESV_ARRIVAL_TIME AS resvArrivalTime, (rr.RESV_CHECK_OUT - rr.RESV_CHECK_IN) AS nights, r.RESV_REQUEST AS resvRequest, rr.RESV_PAY_STATUS AS resvPayStatus FROM ROOM_RESERVATION rr JOIN RESERVATION r ON r.RESV_NUM = rr.RESV_NUM JOIN MEMBER m ON m.USER_MAIL = rr.USER_MAIL JOIN ROOM rm ON rm.ROOM_IDX = rr.ROOM_IDX LEFT JOIN PLAN p ON p.PLAN_IDX = rr.PLAN_IDX WHERE rr.ADMIN_IDX = #{adminIdx} AND rr.RESV_CHECK_IN = #{date} ORDER BY r.RESV_ARRIVAL_TIME

SELECT m.USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, rm.ROOM_NAME AS roomName, p.PLAN_NAME AS planName, r.RESV_ARRIVAL_TIME AS resvArrivalTime, (rr.RESV_CHECK_OUT - rr.RESV_CHECK_IN) AS nights, r.RESV_REQUEST AS resvRequest, rr.RESV_PAY_STATUS AS resvPayStatus FROM ROOM_RESERVATION rr JOIN RESERVATION r ON r.RESV_NUM = rr.RESV_NUM JOIN MEMBER m ON m.USER_MAIL = rr.USER_MAIL JOIN ROOM rm ON rm.ROOM_IDX = rr.ROOM_IDX LEFT JOIN PLAN p ON p.PLAN_IDX = rr.PLAN_IDX WHERE rr.ADMIN_IDX = #{adminIdx} AND rr.RESV_CHECK_OUT = #{date} ORDER BY rm.ROOM_NAME
